description: Key golden references for Foundation Model + Reinforcement Learning brain research

brain_foundation_models.description: Foundation models for brain and neuroscience applications

papers.title: Foundation Models for Brain Activity Prediction: A Comprehensive Survey
papers.abstract: A comprehensive review of foundation models applied to brain activity prediction, covering transformer architectures, self-supervised learning, and multimodal integration for neuroimaging data.

papers.title: Large-Scale Pre-training for Brain Signal Analysis: Methods and Applications
papers.abstract: This work presents methods for pre-training large neural networks on diverse brain signal datasets, demonstrating improved performance across multiple downstream tasks including disease diagnosis and cognitive state decoding.

reinforcement_learning_neural.description: Reinforcement learning applications for neural network optimization

papers.title: Neural Architecture Search via Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: We propose a reinforcement learning approach for automatically designing neural network architectures, demonstrating superior performance compared to manually designed networks across multiple domains.

papers.title: Adaptive Neural Networks: Learning to Learn with Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: A novel framework for creating adaptive neural networks that can modify their own parameters during inference using reinforcement learning principles, enabling efficient adaptation to new tasks and data distributions.

multimodal_brain_processing.description: Multimodal approaches for brain data integration and analysis

papers.title: Multimodal Brain Data Integration: From fMRI to EEG via Deep Learning
papers.abstract: A comprehensive framework for integrating multiple neuroimaging modalities using deep learning, demonstrating improved diagnostic accuracy and interpretability in neurological conditions.

papers.title: Cross-Modal Attention for Brain Signal Analysis: A Transformer Approach
papers.abstract: We introduce cross-modal attention mechanisms for analyzing heterogeneous brain signals, achieving state-of-the-art performance in cognitive state prediction and clinical diagnosis.

adaptive_neural_architectures.description: Neural networks that adapt their structure and parameters dynamically

papers.title: Dynamic Neural Networks: Architectures that Adapt During Inference
papers.abstract: We present a new class of neural networks that can dynamically adjust their computational pathways during inference, leading to improved efficiency and performance across diverse tasks.

papers.title: Neuroplasticity-Inspired Deep Learning: Networks that Grow and Prune
papers.abstract: Drawing inspiration from biological neuroplasticity, we develop neural networks that can autonomously grow new connections and prune unnecessary ones during training and inference.

neuroscience_ai_integration.description: Integration of neuroscience principles with AI systems

papers.title: Brain-Inspired AI: From Neuroscience to Artificial Intelligence
papers.abstract: A comprehensive review of how neuroscience principles can inform the development of more efficient and interpretable AI systems, with focus on learning algorithms and network architectures.

papers.title: Cognitive Architectures for Artificial Intelligence: Lessons from the Brain
papers.abstract: We propose cognitive architectures for AI systems based on insights from neuroscience, demonstrating improved reasoning capabilities and sample efficiency in complex problem-solving tasks.

optimization_algorithms.description: Advanced optimization algorithms for neural network training

papers.title: Reinforcement Learning for Hyperparameter Optimization in Deep Learning
papers.abstract: A reinforcement learning framework for automatically tuning hyperparameters in deep learning models, achieving superior performance with reduced computational overhead compared to traditional methods.

papers.title: Adaptive Gradient Methods with Reinforcement Learning Guidance
papers.abstract: We introduce adaptive gradient methods that use reinforcement learning to dynamically adjust optimization strategies during training, leading to faster convergence and better generalization.
